question: Mool Shanker was the early name of whom among the following social reformers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dayanand Saraswati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mool Shanker was the early name of **Dayanand Saraswati**.
 
• Dayanand Saraswati was a renowned Hindu religious leader and founder of the **Arya Samaj**.
 
• He was born on **12 February 1824** in Tankara, Gujarat.
 
• Dayanand Saraswati promoted the principles of the **Vedas** and condemned idol worship and social evils.
 
• He is well-known for his slogan "**Back to the Vedas**," urging a return to the ancient Vedic teachings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arya Samaj:**

 
 
• Founded by Dayanand Saraswati on 10 April 1875.
 
• Aims to promote values and practices based on the infallibility of the Vedas.
 
• Opposes caste system, child marriage, and gender discrimination.
 
 
 
• **Satyarth Prakash:**
 
 
• Major work of Dayanand Saraswati, also known as "The Light of Truth."
 
• A critical analysis of various religious beliefs and practices.
 
• Promotes rational thinking and Vedic ideology.
 
 
 
• **Shuddhi Movement:**
 
 
• Initiated by Dayanand Saraswati to reconvert those who had converted to other religions back to Hinduism.
 
• Emphasizes the purification of individuals and society.
 
• Aims to restore the Vedic religion and culture.
 
 
 
• **Education Reforms:**
 
 
• Dayanand Saraswati advocated for modern education, including science and technology, alongside Vedic teachings.
 
• Stressed on the importance of education for women and the underprivileged.
 
• Established several educational institutions promoting a blend of Vedic and modern education.
